		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.starbridge DA_GM_seat_academies = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.grand_circle DA_GM_seat_academies = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.weave_unbound DA_GM_seat_academies = yes }
	}
}
DA_GM_seat_lit_foreign = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.abjuration DA_GM_seat_foreign_abjuration = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.conjuration DA_GM_seat_foreign_conjuration = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.divination DA_GM_seat_foreign_divination = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.enchantment DA_GM_seat_foreign_enchantment = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.evocation DA_GM_seat_foreign_evocation = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.illusion DA_GM_seat_foreign_illusion = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.necromancy DA_GM_seat_foreign_necromancy = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.transmutation DA_GM_seat_foreign_transmutation = yes }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.masque_of_crowns OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_divination = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_enchantment = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.oathbound_realm OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_enchantment = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_abjuration = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.living_bulwark OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_abjuration = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_transmutation = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.clay_legion OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_transmutation = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_evocation = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.false_sun OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_evocation = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_illusion = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.council_of_shades OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_illusion = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_necromancy = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.unending_host OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_necromancy = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_conjuration = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.starbridge OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_conjuration = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_divination = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.grand_circle OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_abjuration = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_conjuration = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_divination = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_enchantment = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_evocation = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_illusion = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_necromancy = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_transmutation = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.weave_unbound OR = { DA_GM_seat_foreign_abjuration = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_conjuration = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_divination = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_enchantment = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_evocation = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_illusion = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_necromancy = yes DA_GM_seat_foreign_transmutation = yes } }
	}
}

# The Ward-Wall (Renowned)
DA_GM_level_ward_wall = {
	is_estate_abjuration_level_2_minimum = yes
}
DA_GM_rested_ward_wall = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_rested_tt NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_1 value = 1 } } }
}
DA_GM_can_convene_ward_wall = {
	DA_GM_can_cast = yes
	DA_GM_circle_free = yes
	DA_GM_level_ward_wall = yes
	DA_GM_rested_ward_wall = yes
	treasury = 500
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_mana_75_tt check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 75 } }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_mat_EBM_15_tt check_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 15 } }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_mat_AM_10_tt check_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } }
}
DA_GM_can_release_ward_wall = {
	can_use_magic = yes
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_mana_rl_75_tt check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 75 } }
}

# the rite in the event of the moment (DA_GM_last) has no target and can be released now
DA_GM_can_release_last = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_last_untargeted_tt OR = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 1 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 4 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 7 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 8 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 10 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 11 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 13 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 16 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 17 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 19 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 20 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 22 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 25 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 26 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 27 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 28 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 29 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 30 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 31 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 32 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 33 } is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 34 } } }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 1 } } DA_GM_can_release_ward_wall = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 4 } } DA_GM_can_release_thousand_hands = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 7 } } DA_GM_can_release_great_augury = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 8 } } DA_GM_can_release_book_of_days = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 10 } } DA_GM_can_release_hearts_of_the_people = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 11 } } DA_GM_can_release_great_charm = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 13 } } DA_GM_can_release_thunder_choir = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 16 } } DA_GM_can_release_great_masquerade = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 17 } } DA_GM_can_release_unbroken_memory = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 19 } } DA_GM_can_release_long_vigil = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 20 } } DA_GM_can_release_grey_tithe = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 22 } } DA_GM_can_release_verdant_change = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 25 } } DA_GM_can_release_masque_of_crowns = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 26 } } DA_GM_can_release_oathbound_realm = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 27 } } DA_GM_can_release_living_bulwark = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 28 } } DA_GM_can_release_clay_legion = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 29 } } DA_GM_can_release_false_sun = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 30 } } DA_GM_can_release_council_of_shades = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 31 } } DA_GM_can_release_unending_host = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 32 } } DA_GM_can_release_starbridge = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 33 } } DA_GM_can_release_grand_circle = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GM_last value = 34 } } DA_GM_can_release_weave_unbound = yes }
}
